cohort: The study included 151 patients aged 18-70 years who underwent either total laparoscopic hysterectomy or total abdominal hysterectomy, with or without prior abdominal surgery.
finding: Total laparoscopic hysterectomy (TLH) provides significant advantages over total abdominal hysterectomy (TAH), including reduced blood loss and shorter hospital stays, even in patients with prior abdominal surgeries.
